newsitem.title: USA: College-bound Chelsea Clinton visits Yale.
newsitem.headline: College-bound Chelsea Clinton visits Yale.

text.p: Chelsea Clinton paid a low-key, overnight visit to Yale University Monday, the Yale Daily News reported Tuesday.
Her parents, U.S. President Bill Clinton and Hillary Rodham Clinton, met at Yale Law School when they were students.
Clinton, who is in the process of choosing a university to attend next year, spent the night in a campus dormitory, the report said.
She also attended associate professor Alexander Wendt's class on "Theories of International Relations" with about 100 other students, and ate dinner in a packed dining hall.
Clinton turned down interview requests from Yale publications and people close to her begged reporters not to bother her, the report said.
Clinton and her family have less than two weeks to decide on her academic future, because most top schools require an enrollment commitment by May 1.
Clinton is also considering enrolling at Harvard, Princeton and Stanford universities, the report said.
